methodology.baseline_precision: Exact archived cents and shares; displayed table percentages are rounded.
methodology.selection_rule: Reject any candidate with an observed unranked seed; preserve selected 4400 unless a fully ranked sensitivity candidate justifies replacement.
methodology.means: Arithmetic means across seed-weeks, not pooled order-weighted service.
methodology.gross_margin: Unranked world margins are shown as gross euros; ranked_margin_euros is zero for unranked worlds.
methodology.limitation: Eight selected sensitivity seeds are a stress comparison, not fresh out-of-sample confirmation; Prime has a broader 38-week record.

decision.reason: 43% has the highest mean margin among win targets ranked on all eight paired seeds. This selected stress comparison warrants fresh out-of-sample confirmation before replacing Prime.
